Actress Rashmika Mandanna reveals hip tendon detachment during film shoot

Actress Rashmika Mandanna has revealed she sustained a hip injury, specifically a detached tendon, while filming the movie ‘Mysaa’. She described the film as her most demanding and aggressive project. Mandanna had been absent for several days following the injury. She has now provided a health update, indicating her current condition.
